title: TrueVow EventEnvelope v1.1.0
description: Frozen canonical event envelope. 18 required fields. tenant_id is now nullable for pre-tenant events (e.g. Sales Ops). authority_class enum expanded with tv.salesops.* values. Added optional authority_domain field. Product extensions prohibited at root. Created as v1.1.0 (not v1.0.2 patch) because the semantic change to nullable tenant_id and expanded authority may affect existing consumers.

tenant_id.description: Owning tenant identity boundary. Nullable for pre-tenant events (e.g. Sales Ops discovery/enrichment events emitted before SaaS Admin creates the tenant). MUST be non-null for all legal-product events.

aggregate_type.description: Canonical aggregate type. Legal-product uses ENT-XXX identifiers. Sales Ops uses tv.salesops.* namespace identifiers.

authority_domain.description: Optional field to disambiguate which authority system applies. 'legal' = tv.legal.* authority classes. 'salesops' = tv.salesops.* authority classes. 'platform' = tv.platform.*. If omitted, 'legal' is assumed for backward compatibility.

authority_class.description: Authority class for the action. 6 legal-product classes (SYS_ADMIN through PROHIBITED). 7 Sales Ops operational classes (SALESOPS_OBSERVE through SALESOPS_NEVER_AUTOMATE). Disambiguate with authority_domain field.
